categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in high-power power electronics energy-saving control technology and related products, including high-voltage dynamic reactive power compensation devices (SVG), various high, medium, and low-voltage frequency converters, intelligent energy storage systems, rail transit energy feedback devices, and coal mine explosion-proof and intelligent control equipment. These products serve sectors such as new energy power generation, urban rail transit, metallurgy, power, mining, petroleum, and chemical industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include large-scale power unit cascaded H-bridge technology, big data monitoring and modular redundancy, ring fiber optic multi-machine parallel intelligent operation, grid-adaptive high-performance compensation, vector control, oscillation suppression, multi-machine master-slave control, fast flying start, star point drift, and braking energy inverter absorption technology. The company employs a combination of assembly line and work island production methods to achieve flexible manufacturing, with core processes such as PCB design, software programming, assembly, and testing conducted in-house under cleanroom conditions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are in the new energy sector (wind power, photovoltaic), urban rail transit, metallurgy, mining, power utilities, petroleum, chemical, and municipal sectors. The company serves large-scale wind and photovoltaic power bases, coal mines, steel and metallurgical enterprises, and urban rail transit projects, with strategic cooperation agreements signed with 18 major customers in 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with sales distributed across Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It also has an overseas business division and exports products such as the 690V/1500kW engineering transmission four-quadrant frequency converter to Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of power electronic control equipment. It manages core production processes internally and maintains close supplier relationships for key components like IGBTs and transformers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing power electronics technologies for energy efficiency and grid stability, expanding product lines in energy storage and rail transit equipment, and enhancing digital transformation and supply chain flexibility. R&D efforts focus on improving SVG performance, high-voltage frequency converters, energy storage PCS devices, explosion-proof frequency converters, and bi-directional rail transit converters, supported by increased R&D investment and collaboration with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of power electronic products and systems, including frequency converters, SVG devices, energy storage systems, and rail transit energy feedback equipment. The company also uses a staged payment collection method tied to contract milestones and provides after-sales services. A smaller portion of revenue comes from distributor sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in high-voltage SVG and frequency converters, holding national-level titles such as 'Manufacturing Single Champion' and 'Specialized and New Little Giant'. It competes with international giants like ABB and Siemens in reactive power compensation but has established a strong domestic market presence with advanced technology and broad application coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.7 billion, a 30.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 165.6 million, up 28.7%. Total assets reached RMB 2.755 billion, growing 13.84%, with net assets of RMB 1.273 billion, up 11.22%. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and has steadily increased R&D investment, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, energy-efficient, and intelligent power electronic solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging proprietary core technologies and modular design for reliability and flexibility. Its products improve energy utilization, power quality, and operational safety, particularly in challenging environments like coal mines and rail transit. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive service network, and recognized brand contribute to its competitive differentiation.
